records.rules_text:
(version 1)
(rule "prototype fine geometry"
  (constraint annular_width (min 0.09mm))
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.15mm))
)
(rule "BMI088 fine pitch"
  (condition "A.insideCourtyard('U501')")
  (constraint clearance (min 0.12mm))
  (constraint annular_width (min 0.09mm))
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.15mm))
)
(rule "Manufacturing through-via annular ring"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Via' && A.Via_Type == 'Through'")
  (constraint annular_width (min 0.125mm))
)
(rule "Qualified codec small mechanical via"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Via' && A.Via_Type == 'Through' && A.NetName == '+3V3' && A.insideCourtyard('U701') && A.Diameter == 0.35mm && A.Hole == 0.15mm")
  (constraint annular_width (min 0.10mm))
  (constraint via_diameter (min 0.35mm))
  (constraint hole_size (min 0.15mm))
)
(rule "Mechanical NPTH copper clearance"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && !A.isPlated() && A.Hole_Size_X > 0mm")
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.25mm))
)
(rule "Mechanical via hole to copper"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Via'")
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.20mm))
)
(rule "Plated pad hole to copper"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && A.isPlated() && A.Hole_Size_X > 0mm")
  (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.30mm))
)
